phase: preproof review only; no new proof bodies

gates.name: Feasible direction as one actual operator
gates.needed: From the literal first-order trace equations, construct unique 3x3 T with E coordinates=X*T and F right-coordinates=-T*Y. No supplied operator premise in finalTarget.

gates.name: Integrate actual feasible straight directions
gates.needed: For sufficiently small common t>=0, prove I+tT invertible and the actual inverse-dual path PSD, including rank-one flat cases; exact trace products follow algebraically.

gates.name: Congruence line is scalar
gates.needed: If every I+tT on an interval is a genuine congruence operator, prove T=dI via rank-one P,Q,P+Q+R,P+Q-R; no differentiable congruence selection is needed.

gates.name: Zero-row/column deletion and restoration
gates.needed: Construct finite nonzero row/column core and injections, preserve rank3, factorization and both target properties, restoring actual forced zero factors/directions. Derive PSD rank2 when needed.

gates.name: Normalized inequivalent alternative form
gates.needed: Prove inverse/iff congruence transport, normalize both actual pairs to P/Q, actual shear/reflection, and gamma>0 with alpha,beta,gamma not=(0,0,1); derive actual dual formula with off-diagonal trace weight2.

gates.name: Actual nonscalar zero-pair direction
gates.needed: Construct exact source T and F; square identity/dual determinant and flat case; prove one common positive interval and nonscalarity using spanning.

gates.name: Positive distinct-ray reduction
gates.needed: Apply proved reduction when a positive-case proof requires independent singular rays. This is not the positive rigidity theorem.

gates.name: Positive straight rigidity implies local orbit rigidity
gates.needed: Formalize actual positive finite cone argument (2-rigidity=>1-rigidity) and a proved local-slice/curve argument, or a direct replacement with exact scope. Must include positive-definite factors and all rank-one counts.

gates.name: Closed actual congruence orbits / T1 quotient
gates.needed: Derive coercive bound on S from bounded sums S^T P S, extract convergent subsequence, recover actual row congruence and invertibility, then recover dual factors. Current theorem assumes the limiting S rather than constructing one.

gates.name: Connected actual quotient or explicit factorization path
gates.needed: Construct the actual factorization-orbit quotient and prove connectedness, e.g. via actual nested-ellipse model; cannot assume arbitrary connected quotient or use a witness oracle.

gates.name: Valid local-to-global argument
gates.needed: Prove local rigidity makes the full orbit open using action homeomorphisms, prove it closed/T1, then connectedness forces that orbit to exhaust the actual fiber. Connectedness plus open singleton alone is insufficient.

gates.name: Full unchanged target and canonical package
gates.needed: Assemble uniqueness=>rigidity for all patterns and rigidity=>uniqueness after actual zero deletion/case split, restore original indices, export literal Target with standard axioms, review exact copies, run actual Linux/Comparator.
